mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tighter monetary conditions, leading to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer and business spending, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals labor market weakness, which may indicate broader economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by >0.3 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive 60-day returns during periods of rising unemployment, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail and food services sales indicate strong consumer demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 30% of the time, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which should lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises and payroll employment growth slows, it indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 30% of the time, this hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase and retail sales rise, it indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 25% of the time, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate increases and CPI inflation rises, it may signal tighter monetary policy and inflation concerns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are positive more than 35% of the time, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth exceeds 3% but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 40% of the time, this hypothesis fails.
